snippet.title: Maestro VR | Features Trailer
snippet.description:
Maestro VR

New conducting system. Three ways to play. A full career with talents, economy and a masterclass. And a free Level Editor that lets you turn any piece of music into a playable level and share it on the Steam Workshop.

You raise your hands, and a symphony orchestra answers.

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

WHAT'S IN THIS TRAILER

▸ Two-handed conducting — right hand keeps the pulse, left hand shapes the music
▸ Real conducting patterns for 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7-beat metres
▸ Cues, dynamics, crescendos, accents — and fermatas that actually hold the orchestra
▸ Three modes: Rehearsal, Performance and Pro Performance
▸ Screen on or screen off — the same mode plays completely differently
▸ 38 instruments and voices, up to nearly 100 musicians on stage at once
▸ Musicians who look at you, and lose focus when you cue them badly
▸ Different venues, each with its own acoustics, capacity and economics
▸ A career from Aspirant to Emeritus, with almost 50 talents across three branches
▸ Active techniques you fire mid-concert with the controller buttons
▸ Batons in five rarities, each with its own ability and its own musical era
▸ Full concert economy: patrons, advertising, rent, wages, taxes and critics
▸ An 8-lesson masterclass with exams, practical work and a diploma wall
▸ Left-handed mode, height calibration, and extensive comfort options

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

GET MAESTRO VR
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1327920/

GET THE FREE LEVEL EDITOR
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294210/

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

Maestro VR is in Early Access. Still to come before the full version: more concert halls, and Concert Mode — grouping several pieces into one single, longer performance.

Available on SteamVR.
